CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Conquest and settlement in Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Conquest and settlement in Canaan has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conquest and settlement in Canaan.
